name: Daytona (Windows sandboxes)

modes.label: Windows VM sandbox (presets small/medium/large)
modes.note: Pricing page lists 'OS, Windows, $0.0858/vCPU/h' as its own line next to vCPU/Memory/Storage, i.e. a surcharge ADDED to $0.0504 (= $0.1362/vCPU-h). Presets: windows-small 1/4/30, windows-medium 2/8/50, windows-large 4/16/50 (vCPU/GiB/GiB disk). Default: auto-pause after 60 min idle, auto-stop disabled; paused = disk only.

plans.name: Tier 1-3 (prepaid top-ups, no fee)
plans.note: Org-wide vCPU/RAM/disk pools; Windows presets use 4 GiB/vCPU so RAM pools fill fast (see daytona card).

plans.name: Tier 4 ($2,000 top-up every 30 days)
plans.note: Needed above Tier 3 pool (250 vCPU / 500 GiB).

caveats: Windows surcharge encoded as ADDITIVE ($0.0504 + $0.0858 = $0.1362/vCPU-h) per the live pricing page layout; cards/daytona.json 'windows' mode still encodes it as a replacement ($0.0354 extra). If the replacement reading is right this card is ~$0.14/h too high for windows-large.
Only presets with fixed 4 GiB/vCPU: a 4 vCPU / 8 GiB need is priced as windows-large (16 GiB).
60-minute idle auto-pause tail billed at full rate; disk billed while paused/stopped (no archive for VMs).
Tier 1 and Tier 2 orgs have restricted egress that cannot be overridden (essential services only); full internet needs the Tier 3 $500 top-up.
Creating/Starting/Stopping/Pausing transitions are billed as Started; snapshots created from a sandbox remain billed for storage at an unpublished rate.

fleet.verification: Tier 1: verified email. Tier 2: linked credit card and $25 top-up. Tier 3: $500 top-up. Tier 4: $2,000 every 30 days.
fleet.tiers: Default-region pools (vCPU/RAM/disk): T1 10/10 (or 20)/30; T2 100/200/300; T3 250/500/2000; T4 500/1000/5000. Windows presets hit the RAM and disk pools first (4 GiB/vCPU, 30-50 GiB disk each; running sandboxes hold disk quota, stopped/paused VMs release it). Max concurrent windows-large per tier: T1 0 (30 GiB disk < 50), T2 6 (disk-bound), T3 31 (RAM-bound), T4 62 (RAM-bound). Windows-small on T1: 1 (30 GiB disk). More needs custom limits via support@daytona.io.
fleet.notes: Windows shares organization resource quotas. No fixed sandbox-count quota. Official page disagrees on Tier-1 RAM (10 GiB in access table, 20 GiB in limits table); verify dashboard. GPU allowance not numerically established.
